notes.title: The beta version will be used to test the online version
notes.notes:
In order to test and release the online version as soon as possible, the beta version game ID will be used to test the online version.

This process will last about 60 days.

During this period, when you download the beta version, the game may be missing a lot of content and cannot be played. The official version is not affected.

We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

notes.title: The beta version is now available for download. I am looking forward to hearing
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44645977/c414d22190ee47565e7b0d64af8d68df82d462f6.png[/img]

The beta version is now available for download.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44645977/6e8065a591d5546043fa662cea228aaa8c8a53a8.png[/img]

The game is still under development. It will take at least two years to complete. It will be a long journey.

I hope everyone can express their opinions on the game. My contact information is on the game login page.

notes.title: Open playertest version, available for download this weekend
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44645977/25b5181a3af457b4058e35f4279a450800ec6dca.png[/img]




[b]Open playertest version[/b]

The beta version has been submitted to Steam for official review on February 16, 2025.

It is expected to take 3-5 working days. After the review is completed, it can be downloaded and run this weekend.

Welcome your valuable suggestions.
